rss.title: Multiply or Release - 24 Color Battle Royale in Unity
rss.desc:
Who will win?

Multiply or Release is a fun luck-based Marble Race created in Unity. The main objective is to control all the squares on the board. In order to control them, your turret must fire a marble at them. In order to fire more marbles, you need to get lucky. Each color has its own randomizer. If the marbles in the randomizer hit "x2" your marble count doubles, and if they hit "R", your marbles get released on to the board. Capture enemy turrets to progress faster! That's all you need to know about Multiply or Release, Unity Marble Race. But why are you reading this anyway? Watch the video, or if you already have, go watch another one!
